hebrewText: וַ/תִּבְטְחִ֣י בְ/יָפְיֵ֔/ךְ וַ/תִּזְנִ֖י עַל שְׁמֵ֑/ךְ וַ/תִּשְׁפְּכִ֧י אֶת תַּזְנוּתַ֛יִ/ךְ עַל כָּל עוֹבֵ֖ר ל/וֹ יֶֽהִי

tokens.bdb: figuratively, to trust, be confident or sure
tokens.kjv: be bold (confident, secure, sure), careless (one, woman), put confidence, (make to) hope, (put, make to) trust.

tokens.bdb: to commit adultery (usually of the female, and less often of simple fornication, rarely of involuntary ravishment); figuratively, to commit idolatry (the Jewish people being regarded as the spouse of Jehovah)
tokens.kjv: (cause to) commit fornication, [idiom] continually, [idiom] great, (be an, play the) harlot, (cause to be, play the) whore, (commit, fall to) whoredom, (cause to) go a-whoring, whorish.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to commit adultery (usually of the female
tokens.enLiteralWord: to commit adultery (usually of the female
tokens.explanation: to commit adultery (usually of the female
tokens.explanationEn: to commit adultery (usually of the female

tokens.bdb: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
tokens.kjv: above, according to(-ly), after, (as) against, among, and, [idiom] as, at, because of, beside (the rest of), between, beyond the time, [idiom] both and, by (reason of), [idiom] had the charge of, concerning for, in (that), (forth, out) of, (from) (off), (up-) on, over, than, through(-out), to, touching, [idiom] with.

tokens.bdb: an appellation, as amark or memorial of individuality; by implication honor, authority, character
to spill forth (blood, a libation, liquid metal; or even a solid, i.e. to mound up); also (figuratively) to expend (life, soul, complaint, money, etc.); intensively, to sprawl out
tokens.kjv: cast (up), gush out, pour (out), shed(-der, out), slip.

tokens.bdb: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
tokens.kjv: above, according to(-ly), after, (as) against, among, and, [idiom] as, at, because of, beside (the rest of), between, beyond the time, [idiom] both and, by (reason of), [idiom] had the charge of, concerning for, in (that), (forth, out) of, (from) (off), (up-) on, over, than, through(-out), to, touching, [idiom] with.

tokens.bdb: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
tokens.kjv: (in) all (manner, (ye)), altogether, any (manner), enough, every (one, place, thing), howsoever, as many as, (no-) thing, ought, whatsoever, (the) whole, whoso(-ever).

tokens.bdb: to cross over; used very widely of any transition (literal or figurative; transitive, intransitive, intensive, causative); specifically, to cover (in copulation)
tokens.kjv: alienate, alter, [idiom] at all, beyond, bring (over, through), carry over, (over-) come (on, over), conduct (over), convey over, current, deliver, do away, enter, escape, fail, gender, get over, (make) go (away, beyond, by, forth, his way, in, on, over, through), have away (more), lay, meddle, overrun, make partition, (cause to, give, make to, over) pass(-age, along, away, beyond, by, -enger, on, out, over, through), (cause to, make) [phrase] proclaim(-amation), perish, provoke to anger, put away, rage, [phrase] raiser of taxes, remove, send over, set apart, [phrase] shave, cause to (make) sound, [idiom] speedily, [idiom] sweet smelling, take (away), (make to) transgress(-or), translate, turn away, (way-) faring man, be wrath.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to cross over; used very widely of any transition (literal or figurative; transitive
tokens.enLiteralWord: to cross over; used very widely of any transition (literal or figurative; transitive
tokens.explanation: to cross over; used very widely of any transition (literal or figurative; transitive
tokens.explanationEn: to cross over; used very widely of any transition (literal or figurative; transitive

tokens.bdb: to exist, i.e. be or become, come to pass (always emphatic, and not a mere copula or auxiliary)
tokens.kjv: beacon, [idiom] altogether, be(-come), accomplished, committed, like), break, cause, come (to pass), do, faint, fall, [phrase] follow, happen, [idiom] have, last, pertain, quit (one-) self, require, [idiom] use.
